dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave spline profile with moderate posterior sweep from the apex to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a medium-radius pixel curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base chord width is approximately 1.3 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical beak with high thickness at the base and a sharp terminal taper.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 160 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent caudal flukes with a distinct median notch and symmetrical trailing edges.
